title: "Unit Tests, Integration Tests, and Doctests"

# Unit Tests, Integration Tests, and Doctests
Rust has first-class built-in testing support.

### Unit Tests

Unit tests live in the same source files as the code they test inside a `#[cfg(test)]` module:

```rust
pub fn add(a: i32, b: i32) -> i32 {
    a + b
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn test_add() {
        assert_eq!(add(2, 3), 5);
    }
}
```

### Integration Tests

Integration tests live in the top-level `tests/` directory and test the public API as an external consumer.

### Documentation Tests (Doctests)

Examples written in markdown doc-comments (`///`) are compiled and executed during `cargo test`.
